description: This file defines the RemoteGrainDirectory class, which implements remote grain directory operations such as registration, unregistration, lookup, and handling of grain addresses within the Orleans distributed framework.

classes.name: RemoteGrainDirectory
classes.description: A class that manages remote grain directory operations, including registration, lookup, and unregistration of grain addresses within the Orleans runtime.

methods.name: RegisterAsync
methods.description: Registers a grain address asynchronously, optionally with a previous address and hop count.

methods.name: UnregisterAsync
methods.description: Unregisters a grain address asynchronously with a specified cause and hop count.

methods.name: DeleteGrainAsync
methods.description: Deletes a grain entry asynchronously based on its GrainId.

methods.name: LookupAsync
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous lookup for a grain address by GrainId.

methods.name: LookUpMany
methods.description: Performs a batch lookup for multiple grains and their versions.

methods.name: AcceptSplitPartition
methods.description: Accepts a split partition of grain addresses.
